record.one_liner: ClickUp is a work-management platform for tasks, docs, goals, time tracking and team collaboration.
record.auth_notes: Personal API token (starts pk_, never expires) is sent raw in the Authorization header with no Bearer prefix. OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code grant is documented for third-party apps; its access token is sent as 'Authorization: Bearer', and currently doesn't expire. I classified the personal token as "API key" because it is sent as a raw header value.
record.access_notes: Personal token is generated in Settings > Apps. Rate limits are listed for the FreeForever plan (100/min), and the docs state no plan restriction on API access. I did not check the pricing page. Creating an OAuth app requires a Workspace owner or admin. The docs describe no app review step, though they don't explicitly rule one out.
record.blocker: Rate limits are per token and depend on plan: 100/min on Free, Unlimited and Business; 1,000 on Business Plus; 10,000 on Enterprise. The official MCP server supports OAuth only (no personal tokens). I did not verify API breadth against the full endpoint list, and I did not confirm that no plan excludes API access.
